annotations.title: Send an in-app product to review

description: Sends one product on its way to people: on the App Store to App Review (Apple takes an app's first products only with a version; then it goes when the version is submitted through Ploa, which sends every ready product along with the version anyway). An approved App Store product's changed names or image are a new version of it (ploa_product_get's version.draft), sent the same way while the approved one stays on sale. On Google Play, puts it on sale. ploa_product_get says first what the store still needs under review.missing (listing, price, screenshot, groupName). From an agent this always waits for a person's approval.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
